subject: SOC 2 package reconciliation + request for egress evidence
messages:
From: Maya Rosen <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 package request + egress evidence for procurement

Hi Evelyn / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement is moving this forward and we need to collect your security artifacts to proceed. Can you please provide: 1) the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter if the current period doesn't fully cover our contract start date, and 2) an index or sample of egress logs (or guidance on how you demonstrate data exfiltration controls) so our security team can validate data handling.

We have specific timeline constraints: vendor intake needs docs by Oct 6 to hit Q4 onboarding. If the SOC 2 was recently reissued or re-timestamped, please call that out and indicate effective audit period (start/end).

Attaching a short checklist of what we need.

Thanks,
Maya Rosen
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Health

Attachment: request-soc2-requirements-ACME-20260929.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rosen <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package request + egress evidence for procurement

Hi Maya — thanks for the checklist and the timeline. Quick answers up front: we have a SOC 2 Type II issued for the 12-month period ending 2025-12-31 (PDF attached), and we recently issued a short bridge letter dated 2026-09-01 that documents continuity for key controls during the gap until our next full audit (also attached).

About egress logs: we maintain an indexed export of outbound network flows and data egress alerts tied to our intrusion detection system. I can share a sanitized CSV index showing sample filenames/timestamps and the retention policy (see attached egres_log_index.csv stub) — we avoid sharing raw PII-bearing logs over email; if you need a secure transfer we can provision a temporary download link or a redacted sample.

Questions for you: 1) does Acme accept a bridge letter that documents coverage continuity for a 9-month gap (our bridge covers controls through 2026-09-01)? 2) Do you need signed attestations from our auditor, or is the standard bridge PDF sufficient for intake?

We can get the files to you today if that works. Looping in Marissa from our compliance team to confirm deliverables.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_2025_type2.pdf; bridge_letter_202609.pdf; egres_log_index.csv
From: Maya Rosen <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package request + egress evidence for procurement

Thanks Evelyn — that helps. A couple clarifications from our end: our intake policy allows a bridge letter only if the bridge covers the period up to the contract effective date or the gap is less than 180 days. If your bridge documents continuity only to 2026-09-01, and our expected start is 2026-11-15, that exceeds 180 days. Would you be able to produce either: (a) an interim attestation from the auditor extending coverage, or (b) a short reissued bridge dated closer to Nov that references the same control set?

For egress evidence, the CSV index will be fine for initial review — we'll request a secure transfer for redacted logs if needed. For procurement, we also need confirmation that logs are retained for at least 180 days and that outbound alerts are triaged with documented playbooks.

-Looking to close intake by Oct 6
Maya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rosen <security@acmehealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package request + egress evidence for procurement

Hi Maya — Marissa here from Compliance. Appreciate the detail. On the bridge: we can request a supplemental short-form reissue (a restated bridge letter) from our auditor that moves the letter date to mid-October, which would reduce the gap below 180 days. That typically takes 72 hours once the auditor approves language. If Acme will accept a reissued bridge dated Oct 14, we can aim to deliver by Oct 5 via secure link.

On retention: confirmed — egress-related artifacts (alerts, investigation notes, and index) are retained for 1 year; raw capture is retained per contract (default 365 days). We will include a short summary of our alert triage playbook in the secure bundle.

Next steps we propose: 1) Redwood will request auditor reissue of bridge dated Oct 14; 2) we will prepare a secure Drive bundle with the SOC 2 PDF, reissued bridge, sanitized egress index, and a one-pager on retention/playbook; 3) share a download link and a checklist for intake before Oct 6.

PM'ing Karthik to coordinate the audit request and secure upload.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rosen <security@acmehealth.com>, Liam O'Neill <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package request + egress evidence for procurement

Thanks all — I've pinged the auditor this morning and opened a request (tracker ID: AUD-2026-789). Auditor acknowledged and expects to issue the short reissued bridge by Oct 4, which meets your Oct 6 intake requirement. We will:

- Provide a secure Drive link (read-only expiring link) with the SOC 2 PDF and reissued bridge;
- Include the sanitized egress index CSV and a 1-page retention/playbook summary;
- Provide a point-of-contact for follow-up: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com), our security liaison.

Ben — please be ready to accept any follow-up evidence requests from Acme. Maya/Liam — I'll send the secure link and HubSpot record update once the auditor confirms reissue.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
